comparison.objective: Seat an access panel flush and place two retainer bars across its edges.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential planar insertion and precise placement of loose bars into rib slots.
comparison.success_condition: Panel and bars satisfy position, flatness, overlap, rest, and withdrawal tolerances. No adjustable mechanism or dynamic test.
comparison.reason: Tests ordered seating and placement of loose components rather than fine-tool access, lock preservation, and response-guided commissioning.
